reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2518 b, book 44, باب دُعَاءِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِغِفَارَ وَأَسْلَمَ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ سَوَّادٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أُسَامَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَالْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ وَفِي حَدِيثِ صَالِحٍ وَأُسَامَةَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ذَلِكَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ ‏.‏
en_text: Ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us: 'Abd al-Wahhab narrated to us: 'Ubaydullah narrated to us; (H) and 'Amr ibn Sawwad narrated to us: Ibn Wahb informed us: Usamah informed me; (H) and Zuhayr ibn Harb, al-Hulwani, and 'Abd ibn Humayd narrated to me, from Ya'qub ibn Ibrahim ibn Sa'd: my father narrated to us, from Salih; all of them from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), the like of it. And in the hadith of Salih and Usamah: that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said that upon the pulpit.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2518 c, book 44, باب دُعَاءِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِغِفَارَ وَأَسْلَمَ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَرْبُ بْنُ شَدَّادٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ عُمَرَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏.‏ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ‏.‏
en_text: Hajjaj ibn al-Sha'ir narrated it to me: Abu Dawud al-Tayalisi narrated to us: Harb ibn Shaddad narrated to us, from Yahya: Abu Salamah narrated to me: Ibn 'Umar narrated to me, saying: I heard the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) say... the like of the hadith of these narrators from Ibn 'Umar.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2519, book 44, باب مِنْ فَضَائِلِ غِفَارَ وَأَسْلَمَ وُجُهَيْنَةَ وَأَشْجَعَ وَمُزَيْنَةَ وَتَمِيمٍ وَدَوْسٍ وَطَيِّئٍ
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ هَارُونَ - أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مَالِكٍ، الأَشْجَعِيُّ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الأَنْصَارُ وَمُزَيْنَةُ وَجُهَيْنَةُ وَغِفَارُ وَأَشْجَعُ وَمَنْ كَانَ مِنْ بَنِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ مَوَالِيَّ دُونَ النَّاسِ وَاللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ مَوْلاَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me: Yazid—who is Ibn Harun—narrated to us: Abu Malik al-Ashja'i informed us, from Musa ibn Talhah, from Abu Ayyub, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: 'The Ansar, Muzaynah, Juhaynah, Ghifar, Ashja', and whoever is from Banu 'Abdullah are my allies to the exclusion of other people, and Allah and His Messenger are their protectors.'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2520 a, book 44, باب مِنْ فَضَائِلِ غِفَارَ وَأَسْلَمَ وُجُهَيْنَةَ وَأَشْجَعَ وَمُزَيْنَةَ وَتَمِيمٍ وَدَوْسٍ وَطَيِّئٍ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ هُرْمُزَ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ قُرَيْشٌ وَالأَنْصَارُ وَمُزَيْنَةُ وَجُهَيْنَةُ وَأَسْلَمُ وَغِفَارُ وَأَشْجَعُ مَوَالِيَّ لَيْسَ لَهُمْ مَوْلًى دُونَ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn 'Abdullah ibn Numayr narrated to us: my father narrated to us: Sufyan narrated to us, from Sa'd ibn Ibrahim, from 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Hurmuz al-A'raj, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: 'Quraysh, the Ansar, Muzaynah, Juhaynah, Aslam, Ghifar, and Ashja' are my allies; they have no protector besides Allah and His Messenger.'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2520 b, book 44, باب مِنْ فَضَائِلِ غِفَارَ وَأَسْلَمَ وُجُهَيْنَةَ وَأَشْجَعَ وَمُزَيْنَةَ وَتَمِيمٍ وَدَوْسٍ وَطَيِّئٍ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي الْحَدِيثِ قَالَ سَعْدٌ فِي بَعْضِ هَذَا فِيمَا أَعْلَمُ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Ubaydullah ibn Mu'adh narrated to us: my father narrated to us: Shu'bah narrated to us, from Sa'd ibn Ibrahim, with this chain of transmission, the like of it, except that in the hadith: Sa'd said regarding some of this: 'as far as I know.'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2521 a, book 44, باب مِنْ فَضَائِلِ غِفَارَ وَأَسْلَمَ وُجُهَيْنَةَ وَأَشْجَعَ وَمُزَيْنَةَ وَتَمِيمٍ وَدَوْسٍ وَطَيِّئٍ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَسْلَمُ وَغِفَارُ وَمُزَيْنَةُ وَمَنْ كَانَ مِنْ جُهَيْنَةَ أَوْ جُهَيْنَةُ خَيْرٌ مِنْ بَنِي تَمِيمٍ وَبَنِي عَامِرٍ وَالْحَلِيفَيْنِ أَسَدٍ وَغَطَفَانَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Muhammad ibn Bashshar narrated to us; Ibn al-Muthanna said: Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us: Shu'bah narrated to us, from Sa'd ibn Ibrahim, who said: I heard Abu Salamah narrating from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), that he said: 'Aslam, Ghifar, Muzaynah, and whoever is from Juhaynah—or Juhaynah—are better than Banu Tamim, Banu 'Amir, and the two confederates: Asad and Ghatafan.'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2521 b, book 44, باب مِنْ فَضَائِلِ غِفَارَ وَأَسْلَمَ وُجُهَيْنَةَ وَأَشْجَعَ وَمُزَيْنَةَ وَتَمِيمٍ وَدَوْسٍ وَطَيِّئٍ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ، - يَعْنِي الْحِزَامِيَّ - عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَحَسَنٌ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنِي وَقَالَ، الآخَرَانِ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ لَغِفَارُ وَأَسْلَمُ وَمُزَيْنَةُ وَمَنْ كَانَ مِنْ جُهَيْنَةَ أَوْ قَالَ جُهَيْنَةُ وَمَنْ كَانَ مِنْ مُزَيْنَةَ خَيْرٌ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنْ أَسَدٍ وَطَيِّئٍ وَغَطَفَانَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us: al-Mughirah—meaning al-Hizami—narrated to us, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said; (H) and 'Amr al-Naqid, Hasan al-Hulwani, and 'Abd ibn Humayd narrated to us; 'Abd said: 'informed me' and the other two said: Ya'qub ibn Ibrahim ibn Sa'd narrated to us: my father narrated to us, from Salih, from al-A'raj, who said: Abu Hurayrah said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: 'By the One in Whose Hand is the soul of Muhammad, Ghifar, Aslam, Muzaynah, and whoever is from Juhaynah—or he said: Juhaynah and whoever is from Muzaynah—are better in the sight of Allah on the Day of Resurrection than Asad, Tayyi', and Ghatafan.'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2521 c, book 44, باب مِنْ فَضَائِلِ غِفَارَ وَأَسْلَمَ وُجُهَيْنَةَ وَأَشْجَعَ وَمُزَيْنَةَ وَتَمِيمٍ وَدَوْسٍ وَطَيِّئٍ
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَيَعْقُوبُ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنِيَانِ ابْنَ عُلَيَّةَ - حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لأَسْلَمُ وَغِفَارُ وَشَىْءٌ مِنْ مُزَيْنَةَ وَجُهَيْنَةَ أَوْ شَىْءٌ مِنْ جُهَيْنَةَ وَمُزَيْنَةَ خَيْرٌ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ - قَالَ أَحْسِبُهُ قَالَ - يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنْ أَسَدٍ وَغَطَفَانَ وَهَوَازِنَ وَتَمِيمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Zuhayr ibn Harb and Ya'qub al-Dawraqi narrated to me; they said: Isma'il—meaning Ibn 'Ulayyah—narrated to us: Ayyub narrated to us, from Muhammad, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: 'Indeed, Aslam, Ghifar, and some from Muzaynah and Juhaynah—or some from Juhaynah and Muzaynah—are better in the sight of Allah (he said: I think he said: on the Day of Resurrection) than Asad, Ghatafan, Hawazin, and Tamim.'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2522 a, book 44, باب مِنْ فَضَائِلِ غِفَارَ وَأَسْلَمَ وُجُهَيْنَةَ وَأَشْجَعَ وَمُزَيْنَةَ وَتَمِيمٍ وَدَوْسٍ وَطَيِّئٍ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي يَعْقُوبَ، سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ، الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ الأَقْرَعَ بْنَ حَابِسٍ، جَاءَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ إِنَّمَا بَايَعَكَ سُرَّاقُ الْحَجِيجِ مِنْ أَسْلَمَ وَغِفَارَ وَمُزَيْنَةَ - وَأَحْسِبُ جُهَيْنَةَ - مُحَمَّدٌ الَّذِي شَكَّ - فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ كَانَ أَسْلَمُ وَغِفَارُ وَمُزَيْنَةُ - وَأَحْسِبُ جُهَيْنَةَ - خَيْرًا مِنْ بَنِي تَمِيمٍ وَبَنِي عَامِرٍ وَأَسَدٍ وَغَطَفَانَ أَخَابُوا وَخَسِرُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَوَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ إِنَّهُمْ لأَخْيَرُ مِنْهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ مُحَمَّدٌ الَّذِي شَكَّ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us: Ghundar narrated to us, from Shu'bah; (H) and Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Ibn Bashshar narrated to us; they said: Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us: Shu'bah narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Abi Ya'qub: I heard 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Bakrah narrating from his father that al-Aqra' ibn Habis came to the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) and said: 'Only the thieves of the pilgrims from Aslam, Ghifar, Muzaynah—and I think Juhaynah (Muhammad is the one who was uncertain)—have pledged allegiance to you.' Thereupon the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: 'Tell me, if Aslam, Ghifar, Muzaynah—and I think Juhaynah—are better than Banu Tamim, Banu 'Amir, Asad, and Ghatafan, have they been ruined and lost?' He said: 'Yes.' He said: 'Then by the One in Whose Hand is my soul, they are indeed better than them.' And in the hadith of Ibn Abi Shaybah, 'Muhammad is the one who was uncertain' is not mentioned.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2522 b, book 44, باب مِنْ فَضَائِلِ غِفَارَ وَأَسْلَمَ وُجُهَيْنَةَ وَأَشْجَعَ وَمُزَيْنَةَ وَتَمِيمٍ وَدَوْسٍ وَطَيِّئٍ
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنِي سَيِّدُ بَنِي، تَمِيمٍ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَعْقُوبَ الضَّبِّيُّ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَجُهَيْنَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ أَحْسِبُ ‏.‏
en_text: Harun ibn 'Abdullah narrated to me: 'Abd al-Samad narrated to us: Shu'bah narrated to us: Muhammad ibn 'Abdullah ibn Abi Ya'qub al-Dabbi, the chief of Banu Tamim, narrated to me, with this chain of transmission, the like of it, and he said: 'and Juhaynah,' without saying 'I think.'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2522 c, book 44, باب مِنْ فَضَائِلِ غِفَارَ وَأَسْلَمَ وُجُهَيْنَةَ وَأَشْجَعَ وَمُزَيْنَةَ وَتَمِيمٍ وَدَوْسٍ وَطَيِّئٍ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ، الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ أَسْلَمُ وَغِفَارُ وَمُزَيْنَةُ وَجُهَيْنَةُ خَيْرٌ مِنْ بَنِي تَمِيمٍ وَمِنْ بَنِي عَامِرٍ وَالْحَلِيفَيْنِ بَنِي أَسَدٍ وَغَطَفَانَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Nasr ibn 'Ali al-Jahdami narrated to us: my father narrated to us: Shu'bah narrated to us, from Abu Bishr, from 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Bakrah, from his father, from the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), who said: 'Aslam, Ghifar, Muzaynah, and Juhaynah are better than Banu Tamim, Banu 'Amir, and the two confederates: Banu Asad and Ghatafan.'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2522 d, book 44, باب مِنْ فَضَائِلِ غِفَارَ وَأَسْلَمَ وُجُهَيْنَةَ وَأَشْجَعَ وَمُزَيْنَةَ وَتَمِيمٍ وَدَوْسٍ وَطَيِّئٍ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَهَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ بْنُ سَوَّارٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Harun ibn 'Abdullah narrated to us; they said: 'Abd al-Samad narrated to us; (H) and 'Amr al-Naqid narrated it to me: Shababah ibn Sawwar narrated to us; they said: Shu'bah narrated to us, from Abu Bishr, with this chain of transmission.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2522 e, book 44, باب مِنْ فَضَائِلِ غِفَارَ وَأَسْلَمَ وُجُهَيْنَةَ وَأَشْجَعَ وَمُزَيْنَةَ وَتَمِيمٍ وَدَوْسٍ وَطَيِّئٍ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ كَانَ جُهَيْنَةُ وَأَسْلَمُ وَغِفَارُ خَيْرًا مِنْ بَنِي تَمِيمٍ وَبَنِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ غَطَفَانَ وَعَامِرِ بْنِ صَعْصَعَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَمَدَّ بِهَا صَوْتَهُ فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَقَدْ خَابُوا وَخَسِرُوا ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّهُمْ خَيْرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي كُرَيْبٍ ‏"‏ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ كَانَ جُهَيْنَةُ وَمُزَيْنَةُ وَأَسْلَمُ وَغِفَارُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Kuraib narrated to us—and the wording is Abu Bakr's; they said: Waki' narrated to us, from Sufyan, from 'Abd al-Malik ibn 'Umayr, from 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Bakrah, from his father, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: 'Tell me, if Juhaynah, Aslam, and Ghifar are better than Banu Tamim, Banu 'Abdullah ibn Ghatafan, and 'Amir ibn Sa'sa'ah...' and he prolonged his voice with it. They said: 'O Messenger of Allah, then they are ruined and lost!' He said: 'Indeed, they are better.' And in the narration of Abu Kuraib: 'Tell me, if Juhaynah, Muzaynah, Aslam, and Ghifar...'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2523, book 44, باب مِنْ فَضَائِلِ غِفَارَ وَأَسْلَمَ وُجُهَيْنَةَ وَأَشْجَعَ وَمُزَيْنَةَ وَتَمِيمٍ وَدَوْسٍ وَطَيِّئٍ
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ، قَالَ أَتَيْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ فَقَالَ لِي إِنَّ أَوَّلَ صَدَقَةٍ بَيَّضَتْ وَجْهَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَوُجُوهَ أَصْحَابِهِ صَدَقَةُ طَيِّئٍ جِئْتَ بِهَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
en_text: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me: Ahmad ibn Ishaq narrated to us: Abu 'Awanah narrated to us, from Mughirah, from 'Amir, from 'Adi ibn Hatim, who said: I came to 'Umar ibn al-Khattab, and he said to me: 'Indeed, the first charity that brightened the face of the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) and the faces of his Companions was the charity of Tayyi' that you brought to the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace).'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2524, book 44, باب مِنْ فَضَائِلِ غِفَارَ وَأَسْلَمَ وُجُهَيْنَةَ وَأَشْجَعَ وَمُزَيْنَةَ وَتَمِيمٍ وَدَوْسٍ وَطَيِّئٍ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَدِمَ الطُّفَيْلُ وَأَصْحَابُهُ فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ دَوْسًا قَدْ كَفَرَتْ وَأَبَتْ فَادْعُ اللَّهَ عَلَيْهَا ‏.‏ فَقِيلَ هَلَكَتْ دَوْسٌ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِ دَوْسًا وَائْتِ بِهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us: al-Mughirah ibn 'Abd al-Rahman informed us, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: Al-Tufayl and his companions arrived and said: 'O Messenger of Allah, Daws has disbelieved and refused [to obey], so supplicate Allah against them!' It was said: 'Daws is ruined!' But he said: 'O Allah, guide Daws and bring them [to Islam].'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2525 a, book 44, باب مِنْ فَضَائِلِ غِفَارَ وَأَسْلَمَ وُجُهَيْنَةَ وَأَشْجَعَ وَمُزَيْنَةَ وَتَمِيمٍ وَدَوْسٍ وَطَيِّئٍ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ لاَ أَزَالُ أُحِبُّ بَنِي تَمِيمٍ مِنْ ثَلاَثٍ سَمِعْتُهُنَّ مِنْ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ هُمْ أَشَدُّ أُمَّتِي عَلَى الدَّجَّالِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَجَاءَتْ صَدَقَاتُهُمْ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هَذِهِ صَدَقَاتُ قَوْمِنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَكَانَتْ سَبِيَّةٌ مِنْهُمْ عِنْدَ عَائِشَةَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَعْتِقِيهَا فَإِنَّهَا مِنْ وَلَدِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us: Jarir narrated to us, from Mughirah, from al-Harith, from Abu Zur'ah, who said: Abu Hurayrah said: 'I will never cease to love Banu Tamim because of three things I heard from the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace). I heard the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) say: "They are the sternest of my Ummah against the Dajjal." And when their charity (zakat) arrived, the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "This is the charity of our people." And there was a female captive from among them in the care of 'A'ishah, so the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Emancipate her, for she is from the offspring of Isma'il (Ishmael)."'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2525 b, book 44, باب مِنْ فَضَائِلِ غِفَارَ وَأَسْلَمَ وُجُهَيْنَةَ وَأَشْجَعَ وَمُزَيْنَةَ وَتَمِيمٍ وَدَوْسٍ وَطَيِّئٍ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ لاَ أَزَالُ أُحِبُّ بَنِي تَمِيمٍ بَعْدَ ثَلاَثٍ سَمِعْتُهُنَّ مِنْ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُهَا فِيهِمْ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
en_text: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated it to me: Jarir narrated to us, from 'Umarah, from Abu Zur'ah, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: 'I will never cease to love Banu Tamim after three things I heard the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) say about them.' Then he mentioned the like of it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2525 c, book 44, باب مِنْ فَضَائِلِ غِفَارَ وَأَسْلَمَ وُجُهَيْنَةَ وَأَشْجَعَ وَمُزَيْنَةَ وَتَمِيمٍ وَدَوْسٍ وَطَيِّئٍ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا حَامِدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْبَكْرَاوِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مَسْلَمَةُ بْنُ عَلْقَمَةَ الْمَازِنِيُّ، إِمَامُ مَسْجِدِ دَاوُدَ حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ ثَلاَثُ خِصَالٍ سَمِعْتُهُنَّ مِنْ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَنِي تَمِيمٍ لاَ أَزَالُ أُحِبُّهُمْ بَعْدُ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِهَذَا الْمَعْنَى غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ هُمْ أَشَدُّ النَّاسِ قِتَالاً فِي الْمَلاَحِمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الدَّجَّالَ ‏.‏
en_text: Hamid ibn 'Umar al-Bakrawi narrated to us: Maslamah ibn 'Alqamah al-Mazini, the imam of the mosque of Dawud, narrated to us: Dawud narrated to us, from al-Sha'bi, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: 'There are three traits I heard from the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) concerning Banu Tamim, because of which I will never cease to love them thereafter.' And he related the hadith with this meaning, except that he said: 'They are the fiercest of people in fighting in the great epic battles,' and he did not mention the Dajjal.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2526 a, book 44, باب خِيَارِ النَّاسِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ تَجِدُونَ النَّاسَ مَعَادِنَ فَخِيَارُهُمْ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ خِيَارُهُمْ فِي الإِسْلاَمِ إِذَا فَقُهُوا وَتَجِدُونَ مِنْ خَيْرِ النَّاسِ فِي هَذَا الأَمْرِ أَكْرَهُهُمْ لَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقَعَ فِيهِ وَتَجِدُونَ مِنْ شِرَارِ النَّاسِ ذَا الْوَجْهَيْنِ الَّذِي يَأْتِي هَؤُلاَءِ بِوَجْهٍ وَهَؤُلاَءِ بِوَجْهٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated to me: Ibn Wahb informed us: Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab: Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab narrated to me, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: 'You will find people are like ores/minerals: the best of them in the pre-Islamic period of ignorance are the best of them in Islam when they attain deep understanding of the religion. And you will find among the best of people in this matter [of authority] those who have the greatest dislike for it before they fall into it. And you will find among the worst of people the two-faced person who comes to these with one face and to those with another face.'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2526 b, book 44, باب خِيَارِ النَّاسِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحِزَامِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ تَجِدُونَ النَّاسَ مَعَادِنَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ الزُّهْرِيِّ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ وَالأَعْرَجِ ‏"‏ تَجِدُونَ مِنْ خَيْرِ النَّاسِ فِي هَذَا الشَّأْنِ أَشَدَّهُمْ لَهُ كَرَاهِيَةً حَتَّى يَقَعَ فِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me: Jarir narrated to us, from 'Umarah, from Abu Zur'ah, from Abu Hurayrah; (H) and Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us: al-Mughirah ibn 'Abd al-Rahman al-Hizami narrated to us, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: 'You will find people are like ores/minerals...' like the hadith of al-Zuhri, except that in the hadith of Abu Zur'ah and al-A'raj: 'You will find among the best of people in this matter [of leadership] those who have the greatest dislike for it until they fall into it.'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2526 c, book 45, باب ذَمِّ ذِي الْوَجْهَيْنِ وَتَحْرِيمِ فِعْلِهِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ مِنْ شَرِّ النَّاسِ ذَا الْوَجْهَيْنِ الَّذِي يَأْتِي هَؤُلاَءِ بِوَجْهٍ وَهَؤُلاَءِ بِوَجْهٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us; he said: I read to Malik, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: 'Indeed, among the worst of people is the two-faced person who comes to these with one face and to those with another face.'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2526 d, book 45, باب ذَمِّ ذِي الْوَجْهَيْنِ وَتَحْرِيمِ فِعْلِهِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ عِرَاكِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِنَّ شَرَّ النَّاسِ ذُو الْوَجْهَيْنِ الَّذِي يَأْتِي هَؤُلاَءِ بِوَجْهٍ وَهَؤُلاَءِ بِوَجْهٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us: Layth narrated to us; (H) and Muhammad ibn Rumh narrated to us: al-Layth informed us, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from 'Irak ibn Malik, from Abu Hurayrah, that he heard the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) say: 'Indeed, the worst of people is the two-faced person who comes to these with one face and to those with another face.'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2526 e, book 45, باب ذَمِّ ذِي الْوَجْهَيْنِ وَتَحْرِيمِ فِعْلِهِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ تَجِدُونَ مِنْ شَرِّ النَّاسِ ذَا الْوَجْهَيْنِ الَّذِي يَأْتِي هَؤُلاَءِ بِوَجْهٍ وَهَؤُلاَءِ بِوَجْهٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated to me: Ibn Wahb informed us: Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab: Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab narrated to me, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace); (H) and Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me: Jarir narrated to us, from 'Umarah, from Abu Zur'ah, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: 'You will find among the worst of people the two-faced person who comes to these with one face and to those with another face.'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2527 a, book 44, باب مِنْ فَضَائِلِ نِسَاءِ قُرَيْشٍ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، وَعَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ خَيْرُ نِسَاءٍ رَكِبْنَ الإِبِلَ - قَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا صَالِحُ نِسَاءِ قُرَيْشٍ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الآخَرُ نِسَاءُ قُرَيْشٍ - أَحْنَاهُ عَلَى يَتِيمٍ فِي صِغَرِهِ وَأَرْعَاهُ عَلَى زَوْجٍ فِي ذَاتِ يَدِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Ibn Abi 'Umar narrated to us: Sufyan ibn 'Uyaynah narrated to us, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurayrah; and from Ibn Tawus, from his father, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: 'The best women who have ridden camels—one of the two narrators said: the righteous women of Quraysh, and the other said: the women of Quraysh—are the most affectionate toward an orphan in his childhood and the most protective over a husband regarding what his hands possess.'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2527 b, book 44, باب مِنْ فَضَائِلِ نِسَاءِ قُرَيْشٍ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، يَبْلُغُ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَابْنُ طَاوُسٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ يَبْلُغُ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَرْعَاهُ عَلَى وَلَدٍ فِي صِغَرِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ يَتِيمٍ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Amr al-Naqid narrated to us: Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurayrah, tracing it back to the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace); and Ibn Tawus, from his father, tracing it back to the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), the like of it, except that he said: 'the most protective over a child in his youth,' and he did not say 'an orphan.'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2527 c, book 44, باب مِنْ فَضَائِلِ نِسَاءِ قُرَيْشٍ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ نِسَاءُ قُرَيْشٍ خَيْرُ نِسَاءٍ رَكِبْنَ الإِبِلَ أَحْنَاهُ عَلَى طِفْلٍ وَأَرْعَاهُ عَلَى زَوْجٍ فِي ذَاتِ يَدِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ يَقُولُ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ عَلَى إِثْرِ ذَلِكَ وَلَمْ تَرْكَبْ مَرْيَمُ بِنْتُ عِمْرَانَ بَعِيرًا قَطُّ ‏.‏
en_text: Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated to me: Ibn Wahb informed us: Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab: Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab narrated to me that Abu Hurayrah said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) say: 'The women of Quraysh are the best women who have ridden camels: the most affectionate toward a child and the most protective over a husband regarding what his hands possess.' He said: Abu Hurayrah would say right after that: 'And Mary daughter of 'Imran never rode a camel at all.'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2527 d, book 44, باب مِنْ فَضَائِلِ نِسَاءِ قُرَيْشٍ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَطَبَ أُمَّ هَانِئٍ بِنْتَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي قَدْ كَبِرْتُ وَلِيَ عِيَالٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ خَيْرُ نِسَاءٍ رَكِبْنَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ يُونُسَ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَحْنَاهُ عَلَى وَلَدٍ فِي صِغَرِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Rafi' and 'Abd ibn Humayd narrated to me; 'Abd said: 'informed us' and Ibn Rafi' said: 'Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us: Ma'mar informed us, from al-Zuhri, from Ibn al-Musayyab, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) proposed marriage to Umm Hani' bint Abi Talib, but she said: 'O Messenger of Allah, I have grown old and I have dependents.' Thereupon the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: 'The best women who have ridden [camels]...' then he mentioned the like of the hadith of Yunus, except that he said: 'the most affectionate toward a child in his youth.'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2527 e, book 44, باب مِنْ فَضَائِلِ نِسَاءِ قُرَيْشٍ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ عَبْدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ خَيْرُ نِسَاءٍ رَكِبْنَ الإِبِلَ صَالِحُ نِسَاءِ قُرَيْشٍ أَحْنَاهُ عَلَى وَلَدٍ فِي صِغَرِهِ وَأَرْعَاهُ عَلَى زَوْجٍ فِي ذَاتِ يَدِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Rafi' and 'Abd ibn Humayd narrated to me; Ibn Rafi' said: 'narrated to us', and 'Abd said: 'informed us' 'Abd al-Razzaq: Ma'mar informed us, from Ibn Tawus, from his father, from Abu Hurayrah; (H) and Ma'mar narrated to us, from Hammam ibn Munabbih, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: 'The best women who have ridden camels are the righteous women of Quraysh: the most affectionate toward a child in his youth and the most protective over a husband regarding what his hands possess.'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2527 f, book 44, باب مِنْ فَضَائِلِ نِسَاءِ قُرَيْشٍ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ الأَوْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مَخْلَدٍ - حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ بِلاَلٍ - حَدَّثَنِي سُهَيْلٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مَعْمَرٍ هَذَا سَوَاءً ‏.‏
en_text: Ahmad ibn 'Uthman ibn Hakim al-Awdi narrated to me: Khalid—meaning Ibn Makhlad—narrated to us: Sulayman—who is Ibn Bilal—narrated to me: Suhayl narrated to me, from his father, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), exactly the like of this hadith of Ma'mar.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2528, book 44, باب مُؤَاخَاةِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ أَصْحَابِهِ رضى الله تعالى عنهم
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَلَمَةَ - عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم آخَى بَيْنَ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ بْنِ الْجَرَّاحِ وَبَيْنَ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ ‏.‏
en_text: Hajjaj ibn al-Sha'ir narrated to me: 'Abd al-Samad narrated to us: Hammad—meaning Ibn Salamah—narrated to us, from Thabit, from Anas, that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) established brotherhood between Abu 'Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah and Abu Talhah.
